issues.description: The script uses XMLHttpRequest to fetch external code and executes it via a[a][a](x.responseText), which is equivalent to eval(). This allows remote code execution from arbitrary URLs.
issues.recommendation: Remove dynamic code loading and execution. Only load trusted, versioned libraries via @require.

issues.description: The script stores and retrieves a UUID and a counter in GM storage, which could be used for user tracking. The @antifeature explicitly mentions tracking for performance debugging.
issues.recommendation: Clarify what data is tracked and ensure no sensitive information is stored or transmitted.

issues.description: The script grants unsafeWindow, which allows full access to the page context and can be abused for privilege escalation or data extraction.
issues.recommendation: Remove unsafeWindow unless strictly necessary and audit all usages.

issues.description: The script uses a[a][a](x.responseText), which is a highly obfuscated way to call eval(). This is a code obfuscation pattern.
issues.recommendation: Avoid obfuscation and use clear, readable code.

issues.description: The script loads third-party libraries via @require from greasyfork.org and code.jquery.com, but also loads scijs from greasyfork.org (not official CDN) and msgpack.js (unknown trust level).
issues.recommendation: Only use official, versioned libraries from trusted CDNs. Avoid loading from user scripts unless verified.

issues.description: The script grants GM_getTabs, GM_getTab, GM_saveTab, which are high privileges and may not be necessary for all features.
issues.recommendation: Minimize granted permissions to only those required.

issues.description: The script inserts code via innerHTML and document.getElementById, and may manipulate DOM based on user input or external data. There is a risk of DOM XSS if not properly sanitized.
issues.recommendation: Sanitize all user input and external data before inserting into DOM.

script_name: Lift Web Restrictions: .io Game Mods (MooMoo.io/Krunker.io/..), Ad Link Bypasser, Adblock, & MORE!
summary: This userscript poses severe security risks: it dynamically loads and executes remote code, tracks users via UUID and counters, uses obfuscated code patterns, grants excessive permissions, and exposes DOM XSS risks. It is not safe for use and should be avoided unless thoroughly audited and rewritten.
